desc: convert an Atari compressed Spectrum file to a PPM
r: spctoppm - convert an Atari compressed Spectrum file to a PPM

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

spctoppm reads an Atari compressed Spectrum file as input and produces a PPM image as output.

There are no command line options defined specifically for spctoppm, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
